description: Domain + data layer, list screen MVI, and Koin wiring. Depends on FEAT-001 (string keys and shared components must exist first). Creates all domain models, repository interface, 6 use cases, data DTOs, API stub, mapper, RepositoryImpl with mock data, LiveLessonsContract/ViewModel/Screen/components, and registers everything in a new LiveLessonsModule included by HomeModule. Also replaces the stub LiveLessonsTabScreen with a call to the stateful LiveLessonsScreen, and adds unit tests for LiveLessonsViewModel.
steps: Step 1 — Domain models: Create these 4 files in feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/domain/model/. (a) LessonFileType.kt: enum class LessonFileType { PDF, DOCX, PPTX, OTHER }. (b) LessonFile.kt: data class LessonFile(val id: String, val name: String, val fileType: LessonFileType, val sizeBytes: Long, val downloadUrl: String). (c) LessonExam.kt: data class LessonExam(val id: String, val title: String, val isTimed: Boolean, val durationMinutes: Int?, val attemptStatus: String). (d) LiveLesson.kt: data class LiveLesson(val id: String, val title: String, val subject: String, val teacherName: String, val startEpochMs: Long, val durationMinutes: Int, val status: LessonStatus, val zoomUrl: String, val description: String) where LessonStatus is a nested enum: enum class LessonStatus { UPCOMING, LIVE_NOW, ENDED }.

Step 2 — Domain repository interface: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/domain/repository/LiveLessonRepository.kt with: interface LiveLessonRepository { suspend fun getUpcomingLesson(): Result<LiveLesson?>; suspend fun getNextLessons(): Result<List<LiveLesson>>; suspend fun getLessonDetails(lessonId: String): Result<LiveLesson>; suspend fun getLessonFiles(lessonId: String): Result<List<LessonFile>>; suspend fun getLessonExams(lessonId: String): Result<List<LessonExam>>; suspend fun syncCalendar(lessons: List<LiveLesson>): Result<Boolean> }

Step 3 — Domain use cases: Create 6 files in feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/domain/usecase/. Each is a class with one operator fun invoke(): Result<T> (or with lessonId param). (a) GetUpcomingLiveLessonsUseCase(private val repo: LiveLessonRepository): suspend operator fun invoke() = repo.getUpcomingLesson(). (b) GetNextLiveLessonsUseCase(private val repo: LiveLessonRepository): suspend operator fun invoke() = repo.getNextLessons(). (c) GetLessonDetailsUseCase(private val repo: LiveLessonRepository): suspend operator fun invoke(lessonId: String) = repo.getLessonDetails(lessonId). (d) GetLessonFilesUseCase(private val repo: LiveLessonRepository): suspend operator fun invoke(lessonId: String) = repo.getLessonFiles(lessonId). (e) GetLessonExamsUseCase(private val repo: LiveLessonRepository): suspend operator fun invoke(lessonId: String) = repo.getLessonExams(lessonId). (f) SyncCalendarUseCase(private val repo: LiveLessonRepository): suspend operator fun invoke(lessons: List<LiveLesson>) = repo.syncCalendar(lessons).

Step 4 — Data DTOs: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/data/remote/dto/LiveLessonDto.kt with @Serializable data class LiveLessonDto(val id: String, val title: String, val subject: String, val teacherName: String, val startEpochMs: Long, val durationMinutes: Int, val status: String, val zoomUrl: String, val description: String). Create LessonFileDto.kt with @Serializable data class LessonFileDto(val id: String, val name: String, val fileType: String, val sizeBytes: Long, val downloadUrl: String). Create LessonExamDto.kt with @Serializable data class LessonExamDto(val id: String, val title: String, val isTimed: Boolean, val durationMinutes: Int?, val attemptStatus: String). All in package ...tabs.live.data.remote.dto. These 3 files need import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable.

Step 5 — Data API: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/data/remote/LiveLessonApi.kt in package ...tabs.live.data.remote. This is a class that takes HttpClient: class LiveLessonApi(private val client: HttpClient). Add stub suspend functions marked // TODO: replace with real API call: suspend fun getUpcomingLessons(): List<LiveLessonDto> = emptyList(); suspend fun getLessonById(id: String): LiveLessonDto? = null; suspend fun getLessonFiles(lessonId: String): List<LessonFileDto> = emptyList(); suspend fun getLessonExams(lessonId: String): List<LessonExamDto> = emptyList(). The class is a placeholder — the repository uses hardcoded mock data, not the API stubs.

Step 6 — Data mapper: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/data/mapper/LiveLessonMapper.kt in package ...tabs.live.data.mapper. Add top-level extension functions: fun LiveLessonDto.toDomain(): LiveLesson (map status string to LessonStatus enum, default UPCOMING for unknown); fun LessonFileDto.toDomain(): LessonFile (map fileType string to LessonFileType enum, default OTHER); fun LessonExamDto.toDomain(): LessonExam.

Step 7 — Repository implementation with mock data: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/data/repository/LiveLessonRepositoryImpl.kt in package ...tabs.live.data.repository. Implement LiveLessonRepository. Use hardcoded val mockLessons = listOf(3 LiveLesson instances), val mockFiles = mapOf(lessonId to listOf(2 LessonFile instances)), val mockExams = mapOf(lessonId to listOf(1 LessonExam instance)) inside the class. Each function wraps a fake delay (kotlinx.coroutines delay 300ms) and returns Result.success(mockData). Mark each with // TODO: replace with real API call. syncCalendar: call syncCalendar(titles, startEpochMsList) from core/designsystem PlatformActions and return Result.success(it). Mock lessons: lesson1 (Math Algebra, Dr. Ahmed Hassan, startEpochMs = 1 hour from now approx = System.currentTimeMillis() + 3600000, status=UPCOMING, zoomUrl='https://zoom.us/j/123456789'), lesson2 (Physics Mechanics, Dr. Mona El-Sayed, 2 days from now, UPCOMING), lesson3 (Chemistry Organic, Prof. Laila Farouk, 3 days from now, UPCOMING). Each has 2 files: a PDF and a DOCX. lesson1 has 1 exam (Algebra Quiz, timed, 30 min, attemptStatus='Not Started'). Import kotlinx.coroutines.delay and kotlinx.datetime is NOT needed — use hardcoded epoch values as Long literals.

Step 8 — List screen MVI contract: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/list/LiveLessonsContract.kt in package ...tabs.live.presentation.list. Contents: (a) data class LiveLessonsUiState(val isLoading: Boolean = true, val upcomingLesson: LiveLesson? = null, val nextLessons: List<LiveLesson> = emptyList(), val isCalendarSynced: Boolean = false, val error: String? = null) : MviState. (b) sealed interface LiveLessonsIntent : MviIntent { data object LoadLessons; data object RefreshLessons; data class JoinLiveLesson(val lessonId: String, val zoomUrl: String); data object SyncCalendar; data class OpenLessonDetail(val lessonId: String) }. (c) sealed interface LiveLessonsEffect : MviEffect { data class NavigateToDetail(val lessonId: String); data class OpenZoomUrl(val url: String); data class ShowCalendarSyncResult(val success: Boolean); data class ShowError(val message: String) }.

Step 9 — List screen ViewModel: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/list/LiveLessonsViewModel.kt in package ...tabs.live.presentation.list. Class LiveLessonsViewModel(private val getUpcomingLessons: GetUpcomingLiveLessonsUseCase, private val getNextLessons: GetNextLiveLessonsUseCase, private val syncCalendarUseCase: SyncCalendarUseCase) extends BaseMviViewModel<LiveLessonsUiState, LiveLessonsIntent, LiveLessonsEffect>(LiveLessonsUiState()). init { onIntent(LiveLessonsIntent.LoadLessons) }. onIntent delegates: LoadLessons/RefreshLessons → loadLessons(); JoinLiveLesson → sendEffect(OpenZoomUrl(url)); SyncCalendar → doSync(); OpenLessonDetail → sendEffect(NavigateToDetail(lessonId)). loadLessons(): setState { copy(isLoading=true, error=null) }, launch coroutine to call both use cases concurrently with async{}, set state with results or set error. doSync(): use currentState().upcomingLesson + nextLessons combined, call syncCalendarUseCase, sendEffect(ShowCalendarSyncResult). The ViewModel does NOT take strings — effects carry the navigation/action data; snackbar messages are shown by the screen from string resources.

Step 10 — List screen components: Create 3 files in feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/list/components/. (a) UpcomingLessonCard.kt: Stateless composable UpcomingLessonCard(lesson: LiveLesson, onJoin: () -> Unit, onDetail: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). Card with ScholarlyTeal header, teacher + subject text, JanaDateTimeLabel, JanaCountdownBadge if minutesUntil < 60 (compute from startEpochMs), JanaStatusChip for status, and 'Join Live (Zoom)' JanaAmberButton calling onJoin. Tap on card calls onDetail. (b) NextLessonItem.kt: Stateless composable NextLessonItem(lesson: LiveLesson, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). Compact row: JanaFileTypeIcon (not applicable here — use School icon instead), title, subject/teacher, JanaDateTimeLabel, JanaStatusChip. Clickable via Modifier.clickable(onClick). (c) CalendarSyncCard.kt: Stateless composable CalendarSyncCard(isSynced: Boolean, onSync: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). Card with CalendarMonth icon, JanaSectionHeader(live_calendar_sync_title), desc text, and a Button labeled live_calendar_sync_btn / live_calendar_synced based on isSynced. Use JanaCard from Components.kt as the container.

Step 11 — List screen: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/list/LiveLessonsScreen.kt in package ...tabs.live.presentation.list. Stateful function LiveLessonsScreen(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) uses koinViewModel<LiveLessonsViewModel>() and koinInject<AppNavigator>(). Collect state. Collect effects in LaunchedEffect(viewModel): NavigateToDetail → navigator.navigate(HomeRoute.LessonDetail(lessonId)); OpenZoomUrl → openZoomUrl(url); ShowCalendarSyncResult → snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(message); ShowError → snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(message). Stateless function LiveLessonsContent(state, onIntent, modifier) renders: LoadingIndicator if isLoading; error Text + retry if error != null; else LazyColumn with: UpcomingLessonCard (if upcomingLesson != null) or empty-state text (live_no_upcoming); JanaSectionHeader(live_next_title); NextLessonItem list (or live_no_lessons text); CalendarSyncCard. Use Modifier.fillMaxSize(), background(VellumCanvas), contentPadding(16dp). Import HomeRoute from core.navigation.

Step 12 — Wire LiveLessonsTabScreen stub: Completely replace the content of feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/LiveLessonsTabScreen.kt. The new version: @Composable fun LiveLessonsTabScreen() { LiveLessonsScreen() }. No other logic — the stateful LiveLessonsScreen now owns its own ViewModel and nav wiring.

Step 13 — Add LessonDetail route: Edit core/navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/navigation/Routes.kt. Add inside the HomeRoute sealed interface: @Serializable data class LessonDetail(val lessonId: String) : HomeRoute. Keep Root as-is.

Step 14 — Koin module: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/di/LiveLessonsModule.kt in package ...tabs.live.di. val liveLessonsModule = module { single<LiveLessonRepository> { LiveLessonRepositoryImpl(/* no deps needed for mock */) }; factory { GetUpcomingLiveLessonsUseCase(get()) }; factory { GetNextLiveLessonsUseCase(get()) }; factory { GetLessonDetailsUseCase(get()) }; factory { GetLessonFilesUseCase(get()) }; factory { GetLessonExamsUseCase(get()) }; factory { SyncCalendarUseCase(get()) }; viewModel { LiveLessonsViewModel(get(), get(), get()) }; viewModel { (lessonId: String) -> LessonDetailViewModel(lessonId, get(), get(), get()) } } — the LessonDetailViewModel binding is a stub using parametersOf (the class is created in FEAT-003 but add the binding now so the module compiles; create an empty placeholder class if needed). Edit feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/di/HomeModule.kt to add `includes(liveLessonsModule)` at the top of the homeModule block.

Step 15 — ViewModel unit tests: Create feature/home/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/LiveLessonsViewModelTest.kt following the exact pattern from ScheduleTabViewModelTest (StandardTestDispatcher, setMain/resetMain, runTest, advanceTimeBy). Tests: initial state isLoading=true; after LoadLessons completes isLoading=false and upcomingLesson is non-null; RefreshLessons triggers reload; JoinLiveLesson emits OpenZoomUrl effect with correct url; OpenLessonDetail emits NavigateToDetail with correct lessonId; SyncCalendar emits ShowCalendarSyncResult.
acceptance_criteria: All domain model, repository, and use case files compile without errors.
LiveLessonsRepositoryImpl returns mock data (3 lessons, 2 files each, 1 exam for lesson1) wrapped in Result.success.
LiveLessonsViewModel initial state has isLoading=true; after LoadLessons settles state has upcomingLesson!=null.
LiveLessonsTabScreen compiles and shows the LiveLessonsScreen content (not the old Box placeholder).
HomeRoute.LessonDetail(lessonId) exists in Routes.kt and is @Serializable.
.\gradlew :feature:home:jvmTest passes all tests including the new LiveLessonsViewModelTest.
